abstract: Maintains helicopter emergency evacuation flight profiles and landing pad clearances
system_message:
You are the Aviation operations lead (AVN), responsible for maintaining helicopter emergency evacuation flight profiles, landing pad clearances, and logistical aerial cargo drop parameters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains helicopter emergency evacuation flight profiles and landing pad clearances（HELI）
information_points.content:
AVN-HELI-ZN3：For the Cerro Pabellon High Plateau Setup, the estimated helicopter medical evacuation transit time from the candidate helipad to the regional hospital heliport in Calama under standard mountain wind conditions is 50 min.
AVN-HELI-V5K：For the Paso Jama Ridge Installation, the helicopter medical evacuation transit time between the candidate helipad and the regional hospital heliport in Calama is estimated at 50 min under standard mountain wind conditions.
AVN-HELI-S4S：For the Salar de Tara Caldera Camp, the estimated helicopter medical evacuation transit time from the candidate helipad location to the Calama regional hospital heliport is 35 min under standard mountain wind conditions.

information_points.title: Aerial cargo drops（DROP）
information_points.content:
AVN-DROP-80O：For the Paso Jama Ridge Installation, the maximum certified external sling load rating for assigned high-altitude resupply rotorcraft operating at a density altitude above 4,000 m is 1,800 kg.
AVN-DROP-5VJ：For the Salar de Tara Caldera Camp, the logistical resupply rotorcraft certified for operations at density altitudes above 4,000 m provides a maximum external sling load rating of 1,500 kg.
AVN-DROP-L3W：Under the aerial cargo drop specifications for high-altitude rotorcraft operating above 4,000 m density altitude, the Cerro Pabellon High Plateau Setup supports a maximum external sling load rating of 1,200 kg.
